payload.summary: The council's budget consultation for 2026/27 on Get Talking Norwich, open from 4 December 2025 to 18 January 2026. It asked residents about a balanced budget, a new "live budget" reviewed during the year, a ring-fenced Readiness Fund for the costs of local government reorganisation, and a 2.99% council tax rise. 899 people replied, well down on the post-2019 average of 1,361.
